title: PowerToys Run: one-off startup crash – PowerToys.ManagedCommon 0.98.1.0 not found
author: boardtc

confidence.rationale: The exception shows a version mismatch, but it happened once on an obsolete build with no reproduction path and no current failure evidence.

judgment.rationale: The report is a one-off startup failure on an old 0.98.0/0.98.1 update boundary and the reporter cannot reproduce it or add newer evidence. Current launcher code does not point to a safe localized fix without another current-version occurrence, so the best maintainer action is to close the stale unreproducible report and ask for a fresh bug report only if it recurs on a supported build.
evidence: The exception is a FileNotFoundException requesting PowerToys.ManagedCommon 0.98.1.0 while the visible application version was 0.98.0.0.
The reporter says PowerToys continued to work normally afterward and they do not know what immediately triggered it.
The issue has no bug report ZIP, no reliable reproduction steps, and the reporter’s only follow-up says the issue can be closed if not actionable.

PowerLauncher startup constructs PublicAPIInstance early and depends on ManagedCommon being loadable, so the most plausible explanation is a transient old-version file/update mismatch rather than a stable current code path.
judgment.recommended_action: Close as unreproducible on an obsolete version and ask for a fresh report only if the crash reappears on a current build.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys code fix would be speculative without a current-version recurrence or a diagnostic bundle proving a stable assembly-resolution bug.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Run once failed at startup with a ManagedCommon assembly-version mismatch on the old 0.98 update line, then continued working normally and has not been reproduced.
known_information: The report shows PowerToys version 0.98.0.0 and a missing PowerToys.ManagedCommon assembly version 0.98.1.0.
The installation method was PowerToys auto-update.
The issue has one automated triage comment and one reporter follow-up saying they added everything they know.
inferences: A transient partial update or stale assembly boundary is more likely than a current stable launcher bug.
issue_context.analysis: This does not meet the bar for a new fix design. The concrete maintainer action is to close the obsolete, unreproducible report with instructions to reopen only if the mismatch is observed again on a supported release with diagnostics.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete issue body and both comments.
Inspected launcher startup code in src/modules/launcher/PowerLauncher/App.xaml.cs, PublicAPIInstance.cs, and Wox.Plugin/PluginLoadContext.cs.

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed exception text. At the moment this looks like a one-off version mismatch on the old 0.98 update line: PowerToys reported 0.98.0.0 while PowerToys Run tried to load PowerToys.ManagedCommon 0.98.1.0, and the app continued working normally afterward. Because there is no reliable repro and no current-build recurrence, the best next step is to close this report. If you ever see the same startup failure again on a current PowerToys release, please open a fresh issue with the exact version shown and a `/bugreport` captured immediately after the failure.
